k:逓.mnemonic: Runners wait under each overhang (厂) along the path (辶). One arrives, hands over the towel (巾) as a baton, and the next sets off. Relay (in turn, sending).

k:傲.mnemonic: He refuses to emulate (倣) anyone. He climbs a heap of soil (土), plants his feet above everybody else and lifts his chin. Be proud.
k:傲.hint: Chin up on a dirt heap.

k:沃.mnemonic: After the tsunami (氵) drains away it leaves rich dark mud, and the next crop comes up big (大). Fertility.

k:羞.mnemonic: A freshly shorn sheep (羊) hides its bare pink skin behind a broom (ヨ), unable to face the rest of the flock. Feel ashamed.

k:毀.mnemonic: Someone takes a weapon (殳) to the clay mortar (臼), and it falls in pieces onto the soil (土). Break (destroy, censure, be chipped).

k:捗.mnemonic: Your fingers (扌) walk (歩) down the to-do list, ticking off one item after another. Make progress.

k:倹.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who owns a single suit (合) and patches it himself: a person (人) who will not spend a coin he does not have to. Frugal (economy, thrifty).

k:遜.mnemonic: On the path (辶) the old master steps aside and lets his grandchild (孫) walk ahead, claiming no credit for himself. Humble (modest).

k:喩.mnemonic: To explain genesis (創), the teacher says the world began like a new month (月): first dark, then a sliver of light. One thing described as another. Metaphor (compare).
k:喩.hint: Creation described as a new moon.

k:惰.mnemonic: You have (有) a construction (工) job to finish, but your heartbeat (忄) is slow and the sofa is soft. Maybe tomorrow. Lazy (laziness).

k:款.mnemonic: A samurai (士) wants to show (示) that there is no lack (欠) of friendship: he signs a pact, clause by clause, and shakes hands. Goodwill (article, section, friendship).
k:款.hint: A pact signed with a handshake.

k:朕.mnemonic: A big (大) person (人), alone on his throne all month (月), still says 'we are pleased' as though he were a crowd. Majestic plural (imperial we).

k:痘.mnemonic: A child in a sickbed (疒), covered in spots the size of beans (豆) and told firmly not to scratch. Pox (smallpox).

k:頒.mnemonic: A page (頁) of ration coupons is torn up and handed round so that poverty (貧) leaves no one in the village hungry. Dispense (distribute, disseminate, partition).

k:麺.mnemonic: Barley (麦) flour rolled out, cut into long strings and slurped so fast that they slap you in the face (面). Noodles (wheat flour).

k:遵.mnemonic: The revered (尊) teacher walks a path (辶) and his students keep to it exactly, never stepping off the line he set. Abide by (follow, obey, learn).
k:遵.hint: Students keeping to the teacher's line.

k:賂.mnemonic: A committee member (員) makes you trudge (夂) round to his back door with an envelope before he will vote your way. Payoff (bribe).
k:賂.hint: An envelope at the back door.

k:酪.mnemonic: You trudge (夂) home from the barn with milk in an old wine jar (酉). Left to thicken, it reaches your mouth (口) as butter and cheese. Dairy products (whey, broth, fruit juice).

k:恣.mnemonic: A heart (心) that only asks 'what do I want next (次)?' and takes it without a thought for anyone else. Selfish (arbitrary).

k:謁.mnemonic: As solemn as when you visit a temple (詣): you kneel before the infant king, who receives you from his golden cradle (勹). Audience.

k:嚇.mnemonic: A mouth (口) roaring and a face gone red (赤), then redder still: back away now. Menacing (dignity, majesty, threaten).

k:摯.mnemonic: With an earnest bow you hold out in your hand (手) a round (丸) jar of spicy (辛) pickles you made yourself, offered in all seriousness. Gift (seriousness).
k:摯.hint: Homemade pickles offered with a bow.

k:塑.mnemonic: A sculptor kneads wet soil (土) for a month (月) until a figure seems to sprout (屮) from the lump: the clay version made before the bronze. Model (molding).

k:剝.mnemonic: Soak the old paint with water (水), scrub it with a broom (ヨ), scrape it with a knife (刂), and it lifts away in strips. Come off (peel, fade, discolor).

k:矯.mnemonic: Archers know (知) a bent arrow on sight. A big (大) one is clamped under a hood (冂) of iron and pressed until it flies true. Rectify (straighten, correct, reform).

k:諧.mnemonic: When all (皆) say (言) their part in different voices that blend together, nobody is shouting anyone down. Harmony (peace).

k:墾.mnemonic: A hound (犭) and a badger (豸) attack the stubborn (艮) soil (土), claw (爪) over claw, ripping up roots where no field has ever been. Ground-breaking (open up farmland).
k:墾.hint: Two diggers tearing up wild land.

k:彙.mnemonic: A hedgehog pushes its snout (彑) and forehead (冖) through the rice field (田), gathers fallen fruit under a tree (木) and sorts it: apples here, pears there. Same kind (collect, classify, category).

k:辣.mnemonic: You bite a spicy (辛) berry from a strange tree (木) and shout (叫) for water as your nose burns. Pungent (harsh, cruel, severe).
k:辣.hint: A berry that burns the nose.

k:箋.mnemonic: A halberd (戈) shaves bamboo (竹) into thin strips, each one just wide enough to write a short note on. Slip (paper, label, letter).
